Container.Name: mangia
Container.Overview: Self-hosted recipe manager. Single user, no login, one SQLite file. All settings are optional and can also be changed later at /settings without a restart.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port to reach the app on. http://<unraid-ip>:<this>

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Host folder holding the SQLite database and everything else the app stores. Back it up by copying this folder while the container is stopped.

Config.Name: LLM_PROVIDER
Config.Description: LLM provider: gemini or openai-compatible (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM…). Only needed for URL import, the AI clean-up button, and higher-quality photo reading — leave as-is if you don't want any of that.

Config.Name: LLM_API_KEY
Config.Description: API key for the chosen provider. Leave blank for openai-compatible endpoints that don't require one (e.g. local Ollama).

Config.Name: LLM_MODEL
Config.Description: Model name. Defaults to gemini-2.5-flash for gemini, gpt-4o-mini for openai-compatible.

Config.Name: LLM_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Only for openai-compatible: the base URL of your endpoint, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1 for Ollama.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS
Config.Description: Optional Google Drive backups: the service account's key file, as JSON, or a path to it. Easier to set from /settings, where you pick the file instead of pasting JSON.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID
Config.Description: The Google Drive folder to upload backups into. Share it with the service account's address.
